title: Homemade Cottage Cheese
description: Make your own cottage cheese with just skimmed milk and vinegar — cheap, easy and incredibly fresh.
steps: Heat milk in a pot on medium heat to 90°C / 200°F (just below simmering).
Remove from heat; close lid; rest 20 minutes.
Line a bowl with cheesecloth; pour entire liquid through.
Squeeze out all liquid — curds remain in cloth, whey in bowl.
Discard whey; transfer cottage cheese to a plate to cool.
notes: Macros are per 100g of final cottage cheese. Yield varies. Use in cheesecakes, dips and more.
